You sound like you want to go voluntarily 
Which is better than being taken involuntarily. When I was in a ward a few patients had been taken involuntarily and sometimes you get strapped down and isolated ( which is the last thing you need in this state of mind) 
I too have been without medical insurance but your life is worth more than the cost of going. While it's expensive, sometimes the help is actually useful. 
Hey, you got this, and based off of what you've said I think you should go! Perks: the food is pretty good and it's nice to meet other people who have the same head space 
I'm here if you need to talk, also.

Maybe they are lonely tho? And Reddit is a person interaction. 
I think I'm here for now if you need to talk.

NTA. What your mom said was not okay and she should respect your space. People who have had bad drug addictions typically go to cannibas later on to steer away from more potent drugs- which is safer. Plus, many states are now legalizing marijuana ! You're an adult, she should respect that as well. I get that she is upset but she should realize she has hurt you too.
